title: Time clock
description: Punches from the Hikvision time clock. They are copied every 5 minutes; the API only reads from the device.

status.title: Time clock sync
status.readOnly: Read-only: the API never changes the device configuration.

messages.notConfigured: The API has no CHECADOR_URL configured: nothing is synced.
messages.paused: The time clock rejected the password. Update CHECADOR_PASS in the API and restart it.
messages.running: Automatic sync: {{leidos}} events read · {{nuevas}} new punches · {{restantes}} events left
messages.runningNoTotal: Automatic sync: {{leidos}} events read · {{nuevas}} new punches
messages.pending: The first sync has not finished yet.

sync.hint: Pulls today's punches from the time clock without waiting for the automatic sync.

import.hint: Pulls every punch in the selected date range from the time clock. It may take several minutes; you can keep using the system.

otroHint: Not a valid punch (device code {{minor}}). It does not count for attendance.

errors.status: Could not load the time clock status

reporte.title: Time clock entries/exits
reporte.description: Shifts built from the time clock punches and matched to each employee by their time clock number.
reporte.sinVincular: The {{count}} unlinked ones show the time clock name and the “Not linked” mark.
reporte.regla: The time clock does not tell entries from exits: punches alternate, repeats within 5 min are ignored and a shift lasts at most 13 h.

empleados.title: Time clock employees
empleados.description: Match each time clock number to its system user. The clock prefixes the area to the number (070562 = payroll 562), so the link is confirmed here.
